address: 289 Mu 7, Mu Ban Thap Thai, Chaeramae, Mueang Ubon Ratchathani, Ubon Ratchathani, 34000, Thailand
bio: This riverside restaurant is decorated in a dark regal style – black painted wood with red and gold trim – from the era of the former Lan Chang province. It serves a grand selection of local fish, deboned, in a quintessentially Isan style. The terrace seats are made from dark tree stumps set around rugged wooden tables. It’s an idyllic setting to experience gorgeous sunset views where there has been very little development; just the spectacle of nature....
